title: Isolate ordinary API startup fixtures from owner-local provider discovery
body:
Ordinary API startup fixtures can discover an owner-local Ollama service even when their parent process sets GG_OLLAMA_ENABLED=false.

Source inspection at draft PR #501 integration `d91386a7509a77db4bccdab6f95a3d01e730ad50` found that `apps/api/src/testing/api-subprocess.ts` removes inherited GG_* values without restoring an explicit discovery-disable setting. The in-process startup case in `main.test.ts` reconstructs the same environment. Ordinary configuration defaults Ollama to enabled at http://127.0.0.1:11434 and container admission starts the service. This is a source-supported possible connection, not an observed connection or provider turn.

D243 places that file on disposable hosted runners for the current Mac integration and keeps all coverage/native gates unchanged. Ubuntu coverage and macOS startup run the file, but its Windows-only cases are skipped there; earlier Windows evidence must be stated with its exact source identity. The independent Claude Fable 5.2/xhigh integration review requested this tracked follow-up.

Bounded outcome:
- Give ordinary startup fixtures explicit provider-free defaults after inherited-environment filtering. Preserve deliberate provider tests through named test-owned configuration, not owner credentials or services.
- Check both subprocess and in-process startup. Add a deterministic public-behavior regression that proves a test-owned discovery endpoint receives no unexpected request in the default fixture and that explicit test-owned discovery still works.
- Exercise Windows-only startup/log refusal cases on Windows with a documented maintained test venue, without weakening the existing native launcher suite.
- Reconcile the fixture comment and docs/10 isolation claim with actual environment, process-identity and port behavior. Ephemeral port 0 and point-in-time availability checks must not be described as a fixed port range or universal network isolation.
- Preserve production defaults, owner configuration/stores/listeners, all existing assertions, zero-retry policy and coverage thresholds.

Duplicate search checked all-state issues for Ollama+fixture, api-subprocess+discovery and GG_OLLAMA_ENABLED. #483 concerns SQLite teardown and #442 plugin diagnostics; neither fixes this fixture default.

Parked follow-up outside the five delivered core intents and the bounded Mac integration. No implementation is admitted by this ticket. Future delivery uses GPT architecture/implementation, actual Claude opposing-family review, independent touched-system QA and the repository's existing gates. The current Mac device QA and final audit remain separately required.
